Driver — store/driver.go

`type Driver interface` in `store/driver.go` is the store-driver contract. SQLite, MySQL, and Postgres each implement it via `NewDB(...) (store.Driver, error)` in `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`, `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`, and `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`.
